description: Check a real provider token against the game's login config exactly as player.loginExternal would, WITHOUT creating or linking a player. Returns { ok, uid, username, claims } or { ok: false, error }. Use it to confirm a provider works end to end, and to read what a token carries (e.g. Wavedash's gcid). Ask the user to paste a token from their running build (Wavedash: (await Wavedash.getUserJwt()).data in the browser console).

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

token.description: A real token from the provider's client SDK.

name: verify_login_token
title: Dry-run a login token
